qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: M.Sc/M.Tech degree in Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Biotechnology or related subjects in biological sciences, with first class (60% and above) marks in all degree examinations. Desirable: Good research experience in mammalian cell culture, cell biology, molecular biology and biochemical techniques. Qualification in National level exams such as NET/GATE.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Delhi University South Campus Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website:www.du.ac.in .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.
